name: smwgraphics-earthworm-jim-genesis-what-the-heck
title: Earthworm Jim (Genesis) - What the Heck?
description:
Here you go, the BG is ripped. Here's what the archive includes if you're interested:

-One .map16 file as the BG does consume a Map16 page and a half.
-Palette is easy to edit and the BG uses palette 3. A .palmask file is included.
-BG uses all BG1, BG2, BG3 and some FG2 tiles. There's room for FG.
-Included sample level with BG,
-Evil the Cat is animated. This is the part that did annoy me. Thank god for GENS.

Requested by TypeII_Mound
